capture_method: OneROM live ROM substitution; checksum-protected RBCP; original backup restored and readback verified

observation_profile.phases: NOP bit0 (+2 CCK), EXG bit1 (+3 CCK); conditional branch costs also apply; recorded brackets are authoritative
observation_profile.event_offset: CIA Timer-A latch32+offset E clocks; Copper WAIT line66 h60+2*offset CCK
observation_profile.watchdog: Copper SOFT level1 at line70 h60; all ordinary handlers disable all sources
observation_profile.units: raw VHPOSR words, register flags, absolute stacked PC; no alignment or packed-beam subtraction
observation_profile.launch: pre/post source release VHPOSR; exact bracket cohorts only
observation_profile.limitations: Request readback is not an electrical IPL timestamp; instruction polls and exception entry remain combined in handler beam

repeatability: Single aligned run; neighboring controls only. See independent v7 runs for stability.
uncontrolled_state: Absolute CIA E-clock phase and diagnostic keyboard serial flags not fully preconditioned.
